title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY Hunter College
description: Hunter College students navigate the Upper East Side's mix of high-end dining and reliable late-night staples. From 24-hour diners to iconic pizza slices, these spots fuel late study sessions and post-class gatherings.

cards.title: Midnight Express Diner
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Yorkville Staple
cards.notes: Visit this classic diner for a late-night omelet or burger; it has served the neighborhood 24/7 since 1977.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner on the Upper East Side known for its extensive menu and traditional New York atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Express Diner is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and has been serving the neighborhood since 1977.
cards.source_title: Midnight Express Diner | New York NY - Facebook

cards.title: 7th Street Burger
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Smashburgers
cards.notes: Stop by for a simple, high-quality smashburger; the Upper East Side location stays open until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A popular NYC smashburger chain known for its focused menu and late-night availability near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7th Street Burger location at 1603 2nd Ave is open until 3:00 AM on Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Perfect Cheeseburger in Upper East Side | 7th Street Burger
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Wednesday-Saturday; until midnight other days.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookies Until 3 AM
cards.notes: Order warm cookies for a late-night study break; this location delivers and serves in-store until 3:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery chain specializing in warm cookies, popular for delivery to dorms and libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies on 2nd Ave is open until 3:00 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies | Warm Cookie Delivery & Baked Treats Until Late Night
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM Thursday-Saturday; until 1:00 AM Sunday-Wednesday.

cards.title: Mansion Diner
cards.subtitle: Historic Neighborhood Eatery
cards.notes: Grab a booth at this historic diner, featured in 'Only Murders in the Building,' open until 1:00 AM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned diner serving the Upper East Side since 1945 with a classic American menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Mansion Diner is open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday, and until midnight on other days.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM Friday-Saturday; 12:00 AM Sunday-Thursday.

cards.title: Joe's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Iconic Late-Night Slice
cards.notes: Take a short trip to 14th Street for a quintessential NYC slice; this location serves until 4:00 AM or later.
cards.short_summary: A legendary New York pizzeria known for its thin-crust slices and late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joe's Pizza location at 150 East 14th Street is open until 4:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:00 AM or 5:00 AM daily.

cards.title: The Halal Guys
cards.subtitle: Original Halal Cart
cards.notes: Join the line at the original 53rd Street cart for chicken and rice with famous white sauce, open until 4:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: The world-famous halal food cart that started as a street vendor and now serves late-night crowds daily.
cards.evidence_claim: The Halal Guys cart at W 53rd St and 6th Ave is open until 4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: New York, NY | The Halal Guys

cards.title: Dunkin'
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Coffee Run
cards.notes: Fuel your all-nighter with coffee and donuts at this 24-hour location just a few blocks south of campus.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24-hour coffee and donut shop located near the Hunter College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 882 Lexington Ave (near 66th St) is listed as a 24-hour location in official directories.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Fast Food
cards.notes: Head to 1st Avenue for a late-night McFlurry or fries at this 24-hour fast-food staple.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour McDonald's location providing consistent late-night food options on the Upper East Side.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 1279 1st Ave is open 24 hours a day.

cards.title: Hunter Deli
cards.subtitle: Campus-Adjacent Bodega
cards.notes: Grab a classic bacon, egg, and cheese or a sandwich at this deli located directly across from the North Building.
cards.short_summary: A popular deli and bodega for Hunter students, offering a wide range of quick meals and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Hunter Deli at 966 Lexington Ave is a primary food source for students, located right by the 68th St station.
cards.source_title: Hunter Deli :: Best American in New York
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typically closes around 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Wasi's Food Truck
cards.subtitle: North Building Halal Cart
cards.notes: Visit this campus landmark for chicken over rice; it's a ritual for many students between or after classes.
cards.short_summary: A beloved halal food truck parked outside Hunter College's North Building, known for its friendly service.
cards.evidence_claim: Wasi's Food Truck is a recognized campus landmark for Hunter College students, serving breakfast and lunch classics.
cards.source_title: Wasi's Food Truck – Food Atlas of New York
cards.access_notes: Located outside the North Building; hours vary by day but typically serves through the evening.
